name: AI Content Drop
original_description: Choose a model and watch the finished video or image appear in the conversation. Write and produce a short vertical drama episode by episode, hand a whole campaign to Drop, the video agent, turn a brief into a finished captioned ad, lay the work out on a board you can open full screen, and research the ads competitors run. Nothing is made until you confirm it, and a step that fails uses nothing. Browse models anonymously; sign in to create and see your history.
summary_ja: 動画や画像、字幕付き広告、縦型ドラマなどの制作を支援する。
limitations_ja: モデルの閲覧は匿名可。作成と履歴の閲覧にはサインインが必要。ユーザーが確認するまで生成しないと説明。
